S6:17.text: Iacob therefore roſe vp, and ſetting his children and wiues vpon camels, went his way

S6:18.text: And he tooke al his ſubſtance, and flocks, and whatſoeuer he had gotten in Meſopotamia and went forward to Iſaac his father into the land of Chanaan.

S6:20.text: And Iacob would not confeſſe to his father in law that he fled.

S6:24.text: And he ſaw in his ſleep God ſaying vnto him: Take heed thou ſpeake not roughly anie thing againſt Iacob.

S6:25.text: And Iacob had now pitched his tent in the mountaine: and when he with his brethren had ouertaken him, he pitched his tent in the ſame Mount Galaad.

S6:26.text: And he ſaid to Iacob: Why dideſt thou ſo, that vnwitting unto me thou wouldeſt carie away my daughters as captiues with the ſword?

S6:27.text: Why wouldeſt thou fly without my knowledge, and not tel me, that I might haue brought thee on the way with ioy, and ſongs, and timbrels, and cithernes

S6:28.text: Thou haſt not ſuffred me to kiſſe my ſonnes and daughters thou haſt done fooliſhly: now alſo indeed.
